meta.name: campaign-strategy
meta.description: Pre-flight strategy advisor for a new campaign. Analyses every past campaign in the local YALC DB (HeyReach campaigns auto-sync on each run), their real outbound copy, where in the sequence each conversation first replied, every prior retro brief, and the validated/proven intelligence file. Then it proposes angle, audience, batch size, channel choice, and concrete testable hypotheses for the campaign you are about to launch. Does NOT draft outbound copy — that is refine-outbound-copy's job. Use when someone says 'I want to launch a campaign for X', 'how should we approach this campaign', 'what should we test next', 'strategy for the next campaign', or 'campaign manager' in the context of building a new campaign.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析历史数据，为营销活动提供策略建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要基于过往数据制定新营销活动的策略。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze past campaigns to propose strategy for new ones
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need data-driven strategy for launching new marketing campaigns.

howto.what: 当用户要求制定新活动策略时，Claude会自动同步并分析所有历史活动数据（包括外呼文案、首次回复位置、回顾简报等），然后提出活动角度、目标受众、批次规模、渠道选择及可测试假设，但不直接写外呼文案。
howto.when: 当用户说出“I want to launch a campaign for X”、“how should we approach this campaign”、“what should we test next”等，或提及“campaign manager”时触发。

say.text: 我想为[目标]发起一个活动。
say.note: Claude会分析历史数据并给出策略建议。

say.text: 下次活动应该测试什么？
say.note: Claude会基于过去活动提出测试假设。

say.text: 帮我制定新活动的策略。
say.note: Claude会生成角度、受众、渠道等建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to plan a new campaign, Claude auto-syncs and analyzes all past campaign data (real outbound copy, first-reply step, retro briefs, validated intelligence), then proposes angle, audience, batch size, channel, and testable hypotheses. It does not draft outbound copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'I want to launch a campaign for X', 'how should we approach this campaign', 'what should we test next', or mentions 'campaign manager' in the context of building a new campaign.

say_en.text: I want to launch a campaign for [target].
say_en.note: Claude analyzes historical data and suggests a strategy.
Claude proposes hypotheses based on past campaigns.

say_en.text: Help me build a strategy for a new campaign.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a brief with angle, audience, channel, etc.
